description: LSS-LRTA* (Local Search Space LRTA*) is a real-time search that looks further ahead than LRTA*. In each step it runs A* from the agent's state for at most `n` expansions. Then it runs Dijkstra's algorithm backwards from the A* open list and sets each expanded state's value to its cheapest cost to that frontier. The agent moves along the A* path to the best open state and plans again. From an admissible table the values stay admissible. A larger `n` gives better moves for more work per step.

papers.title: Comparing real-time and incremental heuristic search for real-time situated agents
